items.title: Platinum Group Metals Ltd. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
items.summary: Platinum Group Metals (NYSE American: PLG, TSX: PTM) reported third quarter fiscal 2026 results for the period ended May 31, 2026 and provided a Waterberg project update. The company’s key asset is the Waterberg platinum group metals project in South Africa, held through Waterberg JV Resources, where Platinum Group’s direct interest is 37.42% plus a 12.97% indirect interest via Mnombo.For the nine months ended May 31, 2026, the company recorded a net loss of $2.88 million (vs. $3.40 million a year earlier), or $0.02 basic and diluted loss per share. Finance income was $0.97 million. Waterberg project expenditures were about $1.8 million, bringing accumulated net costs capitalized to $55.2 million and total project spend since inception to approximately $92.9 million.Funding activities included completing the 2025 ATM program with 22.73 million shares sold for $50 million gross, and launching a new 2026 ATM of up to $60 million, under which 1.06 million shares were sold in the quarter for $2.01 million gross. A Rand 92.1 million Stage Six Budget and a Rand 27.4 million supplemental T-Zone budget support pre-construction, metallurgical drilling and staged mine development studies, alongside early site works, power, water and community infrastructure programs.

items.title: Platinum Group Metals Ltd. Announces Non-Brokered Private Placement
items.summary: Platinum Group Metals (NYSE: PLG) has announced a non-brokered private placement to raise US$1,008,000 through the sale of 800,000 common shares at US$1.26 per share to Hosken Consolidated Investments Limited (HCI). The offering price represents a 3.1% premium to the company's 5-day VWAP on NYSE American as of May 9, 2025. The proceeds will fund pre-construction work, engineering, and preparation costs at the Waterberg Project in South Africa, along with general corporate purposes. This placement will restore HCI's ownership stake to 26% in the company. The shares will be subject to a four-month plus one-day trading restriction period following the closing.
